t_advice_summary_textbox.text: learn colors of gnomes as they give different amounts of points

vb_textbox.text: Purple, yellow, orange, and pink gnomes will give you a yellow basket, the other colors (green, blue, brown, red) will give you a red basket. I found that the red basket usually gives you more but it may differ round to round. Also, the gnomes colors that gave red gave me a lot of mushrooms everytime i picked them until it gave me a low amound on a 5x. I think at that point the round swapped which color gives you more so i started picking the gnome that gave me the yellow basket.
